title: National Accounts Statistics: Compilation and GDP Estimation
provider: National Statistical Systems Training Academy (NSSTA), Greater Noida
description: A residential programme on the compilation of national accounts following the System of National Accounts framework. Covers the production, income and expenditure approaches to GDP, the supply and use framework, deflation to constant prices, and the treatment of the unorganised sector. Participants work with actual compilation worksheets from a recent base-year revision.

title: Price Statistics: CPI and WPI Compilation
provider: National Statistical Systems Training Academy (NSSTA), Greater Noida
description: Covers the construction and maintenance of consumer and wholesale price indices. Includes item basket selection, weighting diagrams from consumption expenditure surveys, price collection protocols and quality adjustment, index formulae, and base-year revision. Participants diagnose and correct faults in a sample price return before it enters the index.

title: Advanced Sampling Techniques for Large-Scale Surveys
provider: National Statistical Systems Training Academy (NSSTA), Greater Noida
description: An advanced programme on the sampling methodology behind national household and enterprise surveys. Covers frame construction and maintenance, stratification strategy, allocation under cost constraints, rotation panels, variance estimation for multistage designs, and small area estimation. Participants defend a proposed design against a precision and cost brief.

title: Database Management for Statistical Offices
provider: National Statistical Systems Training Academy (NSSTA), Greater Noida
description: A blended programme on running the databases that hold survey and administrative statistical data. Covers schema design for schedule data, indexing for large tabulation workloads, transaction handling during data entry, backup and recovery obligations, and access control for confidential unit records. Includes supervised laboratory work on a live survey database.

title: GIS Applications in Survey Frames and Sampling
provider: National Statistical Systems Training Academy (NSSTA), Greater Noida
description: A laboratory-based programme applying geographic information systems to survey operations. Covers digitisation of enumeration block boundaries, geocoding of sampling frames, spatial checks on field coverage, and the use of satellite-derived built-up area layers to update urban frames between censuses. Participants build a geocoded frame for one district.

title: SDG Monitoring and Data Gap Assessment
provider: National Statistical Systems Training Academy (NSSTA), Greater Noida
description: Covers the statistical machinery behind SDG monitoring at national and state level. Includes indicator metadata compilation, assessment of data gaps against the National Indicator Framework, use of administrative sources to fill them, and the coordination arrangements between line ministries and the statistical office. Participants produce a gap assessment for one goal.

title: Labour Force Statistics and the PLFS
provider: National Statistical Systems Training Academy (NSSTA), Greater Noida
description: Covers the measurement of employment and unemployment in India. Includes the international definitions of labour force participation, activity status on usual and current weekly status, informal sector and informal employment measurement, and the rotational panel design of the Periodic Labour Force Survey. Participants compute headline rates from a real round and reconcile them against the published series.

title: Agricultural Statistics and Crop Estimation
provider: National Statistical Systems Training Academy (NSSTA), Greater Noida
description: Covers the estimation of agricultural area, production and yield. Includes crop cutting experiments and the General Crop Estimation Survey, land use classification and area enumeration, livestock and fisheries statistics, and the integration of remote sensing with traditional field enumeration. Participants supervise a simulated crop cutting and assess the resulting yield estimate.

title: Industrial Statistics: ASI and the IIP
provider: National Statistical Systems Training Academy (NSSTA), Greater Noida
description: Covers the measurement of industrial activity. Includes the Annual Survey of Industries frame and schedule, compilation of the Index of Industrial Production, maintenance of the business register, the National Industrial Classification, and the treatment of the factory and non-factory segments. Participants trace an item from a factory return through to the published index.

title: Metadata Standards, SDMX and Statistical Classifications
provider: National Statistical Systems Training Academy (NSSTA), Greater Noida
description: Covers the documentation that makes statistical data findable and reusable. Includes the Generic Statistical Business Process Model, SDMX for data and metadata exchange, DDI for microdata documentation, the National Industrial and Occupational Classifications, and the construction of concordances when a classification is revised. Participants document one survey end to end.

title: Data Quality Assurance for Official Statistics
provider: National Statistical Systems Training Academy (NSSTA), Greater Noida
description: An advanced programme on assuring the quality of published statistics. Covers the quality dimensions of relevance, accuracy, timeliness, accessibility, coherence and comparability, the National Quality Assurance Framework, editing and imputation strategy, decomposition of sampling and non-sampling error, and the publication of a quality declaration alongside a release.

title: Government Cloud and MeghRaj for Statistical Systems
provider: National Statistical Systems Training Academy (NSSTA), Greater Noida
description: Covers deploying statistical systems on government cloud infrastructure. Includes the MeghRaj policy, empanelled cloud service providers and their audit obligations, data localisation requirements, the National Informatics Centre hosting model, and the security clearance and procurement path for a new deployment. Participants prepare a hosting proposal for a survey platform.

title: Leadership for Senior Statistical Officers
provider: National Statistical Systems Training Academy (NSSTA), Greater Noida
description: A residential programme for officers taking charge of a statistical division. Covers setting direction under competing demands, delegation and development of technical staff, difficult performance conversations, building analytical capability inside a unit, and representing a statistical position to administrative leadership without overstating what the evidence supports.
